title: WCD UP Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 678 Anganwadi Worker and Helper Posts
description: The Women and Child Development Department (WCD UP) has issued the latest job notification for recruitment in 2026. To fill 678 vacancies for Anganwadi Worker and Helper Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the 10th Pass and Intermediate (10+2) can apply for the WCD UP Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
